headline: Is Aptiv (APTV) Cheap Following Its Q2 2026 Earnings Outlook?
summary: Aptiv (APTV) is drawing fresh attention as investors look ahead to its upcoming second quarter 2026 report. Expectations center on weaker revenue and earnings, with supply chain issues and customer mix under scrutiny. See our latest analysis for Aptiv. Aptiv's share price has drifted lower in recent months, with a 30 day share price return of 6.32% and a year to date share price decline of 28.01%, even though the 1 year total shareholder return is slightly positive at 1.54%.
